name: ESPN Fantasy
description: Reads and operates live ESPN Fantasy Football draft rooms, including player availability, queues, autopick, rosters, and draft selections.

tools.name: get_espn_fantasy_draft_state
tools.description: Return the current live-draft clock, turn, team, autopick, queue, and roster state.

tools.name: list_espn_fantasy_available_players
tools.description: Optionally switch ESPN's position filter, then return the currently rendered available players and stable ESPN player IDs.

tools.name: list_espn_fantasy_pick_history
tools.description: Return completed picks currently loaded in the draft room.

tools.name: queue_espn_fantasy_player
tools.description: Add an available player to the user's draft queue.

tools.name: remove_espn_fantasy_queued_player
tools.description: Remove a player from the user's draft queue.

tools.name: set_espn_fantasy_autopick
tools.description: Enable or disable autopick for the current draft room.

tools.name: draft_espn_fantasy_player
tools.description: Draft a currently rendered player after validating the expected pick number; activate the player's position first when another ESPN position view is selected.
